description: This is a C# source file defining the internal class SiloStatusListenerManager, which manages ISiloStatusListener instances, subscribes/unsubscribes listeners, processes membership updates, and notifies listeners of status changes within the Orleans runtime membership service.

classes.name: SiloStatusListenerManager
classes.description: Manages silo status listeners, handling subscription, unsubscription, membership updates processing, and observer notification within the Orleans membership system.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Adds a new silo status listener if it isn't already registered.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes a registered silo status listener if it exists.

methods.name: ProcessMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Asynchronously processes membership updates and notifies observers of changes.

methods.name: NotifyObservers
methods.description: Notifies all registered listeners about membership status changes.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Implements ILifecycleParticipant to manage the lifecycle events for starting and stopping the membership update processing.
